name: In-place word swap
description: The text stays where it is: the old word masks out upward, the new one rises in at the same spot.

recipe.build: One overflow:hidden line box, two stacked spans, y 100% to 0 and 0 to -100% over 0.35 s power3.out; static words never move.

use_when: Any refrain, ladder or changing object; the default way to change a word.
avoid: Never reposition the line; never fade a swap in a different place.

code.example: RasanMoves.inPlaceWordSwap(tl, 0.3, { target: stage, prefix: 'Built to be', words: ['fast', 'safe', 'yours'] });
